caption: The drawing features twelve figures arranged in three vertical rows with four figures each, against a plain beige background. Each figure has a stylized, doll-like appearance with simplified facial features and body shapes. The figures alternate between two types of attire: one group wears black coats, black pants, and white collars, while the other wears brown dresses with white collars and head coverings. Several figures have gray or white hair, and a few have red faces. Some of the male figures hold canes in their right hands. The figures are rendered in a flat, matte style, with minimal shading and detail, and are spaced evenly apart in a grid-like composition. The color palette consists primarily of black, brown, beige, white, and touches of red.
title: Plate of Dolls
